text.en:
The name of the Bolo Norte Elementary School in Barangay Bolo Norte in the Municipality of
Sipocot, Province of Camarines Sur, is hereby changed to Soledad R. Villafuerte Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
